title: Number of Ways to Separate Numbers
goal: Count partitions into positive nondecreasing decimal integers without leading zeroes.
strategy: DP records a prefix and its final number length. All shorter previous lengths are automatically smaller; an equal-length predecessor needs a lexicographic comparison. Prefix sums combine shorter lengths efficiently.
